title: Hot Bus Robbery
brief: Shina's levy danfo does its round on the expressway with the week's collections on board. Take the bus, lose the Red Cowries, hide it.
standout: A hijacked danfo flat out down the expressway.

objectives.text: Take the levy bus's guard down

say.speaker: The expressway
lines: Tunde: Shina's collection bus. One guard, one driver wey dey chop gala.
Tunde: Papa's danfo paid that levy for ten years.

objectives.sub: Down the expressway before their bikes box you in
objectives.late: The Red Cowries' bikes boxed the bus in.

objectives.text: Lose whoever is still behind you

objectives.sub: Back past Anthony, off the road

sayDone.speaker: Tunde
lines: Tunde: First real money wey I ever hold. And e be Shina own.
